summary: The missions and work list refreshers go back to catching up in chunks of 100 rows. This reverts the unchunked last catch-up round, which held one long fold at bursts of changes, and reopens #5122.

replay.detail: No replay trigger or recovery wait. The lists are in-memory publications folded from the existing projections.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or migrations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, registry or coordinated member upgrade change.

compatibility.detail: The published rows are the ones the direct read gives at the publication's cut, as before. Nothing is written, replicated or sent differently, so mixed-version fleets interoperate unchanged. Every catch-up round again folds at most 100 changed rows in one read snapshot.

downtime.detail: No storage migration or added startup work.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure. During a burst that changes more than 100 rows in every catch-up round, a refresher again logs 'kept changing in ways no short fold can follow' and keeps its previous publication until a later fold catches up (#5122).

recovery.detail: The previous build's single unchunked last round returns with that build; nothing is stored.
